notes: Daily GL entries: legacy numbering CALC_SERIAL, line defaults (VAT customer of AC_BENF_TAX, VAT memo, invoice date), header/line/cost-centre checks, balance and budget checks, running totals and account balances, buttons TAX_IN / TAX_NOTES / POST_VOUCHER, delete rules (APP_RULES_GL / APP_ACT_AR / APP_PROC_GL, see processes/ACDLYTR.md)

rules.where: (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (ENTRY_YEAR, ENTRY_TYPE) in (select ENTRY_YEAR, ENTRY_TYPE from AC_PASSWORD_ENTRY where PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

validations.name: رأس القيد: النوع والتاريخ والفترة المقفلة والعملة ورقم المستند
validations.plsql: return app_rules_gl.check_header(:PAGE_ROWID, to_number(:PAGE_ENTRY_YEAR), to_number(:PAGE_ENTRY_TYPE), to_number(:PAGE_ENTRY_NO), to_date(:PAGE_ENTRY_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), to_number(:PAGE_DOC_NO), to_number(:PAGE_CURRENCY_CODE), to_number(:PAGE_RATE));

after_save.name: تفاصيل القيد: الحسابات ومراكز التكلفة والتوازن والموازنة التقديرية

AC_DAILY_TRN.ENTRY_YEAR.lov: select distinct entry_year d, entry_year r from ac_trn_codes order by 1

AC_DAILY_TRN.ENTRY_TYPE.lov: select entry_type || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(entry_desc_e, entry_desc) else entry_desc end d, entry_type r from ac_trn_codes where entry_year = :PAGE_ENTRY_YEAR and nvl(ac_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (entry_year, entry_type) in (select p1.entry_year, p1.entry_type from ac_password_entry p1 where p1.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p1.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by entry_type

AC_DAILY_TRN_DET.CUST_CODE.lov: select benf_code || ' - ' || benf_name || ' (' || tax_no || ')' d, benf_code r from ac_benf_tax order by benf_code

AC_DAILY_TRN.CREATE_USER_NAME.sql: (select max(u.users_name) from users u where u.users_code = t.create_user_code) || ' ' || to_char(t.create_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')

AC_DAILY_TRN.UPDATE_USER_NAME.sql: (select max(u.users_name) from users u where u.users_code = t.update_user_code) || ' ' || to_char(t.update_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')

AC_DAILY_TRN_DET.CUST_TAX_VAL.sql: case when nvl(t.tax_flag, 0) = 1 then abs(t.value) else abs(t.value) - t.cust_inv_val end

AC_DAILY_TRN_DET.CUST_TOT_VAL.sql: nvl(t.cust_inv_val, 0) + nvl(case when nvl(t.tax_flag, 0) = 1 then abs(t.value) else abs(t.value) - t.cust_inv_val end, 0)

AC_DAILY_TRN_DET.CURRENT_LOC_F.sql: (select case when b.v > 0 then to_char(b.v, 'FM999G999G999G990D00') || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then ' Debit' else ' مـديـن' end when b.v < 0 then to_char(-b.v, 'FM999G999G999G990D00') || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then ' Credit' else ' دائــن' end end from (select get_account_bal_level(to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE), t.account_number) v from dual) b)
